newsitem.title: USA: U.S. presses Israel, Palestinians on Hebron.
newsitem.headline: U.S. presses Israel, Palestinians on Hebron.

text.p: The United States pressed Israel and the Palestinians on Thursday to close an agreement on Hebron, saying a deal is "there for the taking."

After a telephone conversation with U.S. special envoy Dennis Ross, mediating the protracted negotiations, State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns said: "It's our view...that it's really up to the Israel and the Palestinians to finish this deal."
